payload.title: Low-dimensional nonlinear coefficient learning
payload.statement: Split-local prediction of a small number of nonlinear correction coefficients or control points can recover materially more of E010 candidate coverage than flat family/candidate ranking, while remaining memory-safe and falling back exactly to E006 when confidence is weak.
payload.evidence_for: E010 bank oracle is 4.7511. A counterfactual granting oracle coefficients to the families actually chosen by the selector is 5.7075, while the real selector is 14.7803. Coefficient estimation and aggregation explain 90.46% of the total selector gap.
payload.evidence_against: Legal features may still be too weak to infer signed nonlinear coefficients under spatial shift. E008/E009 learned datum action only weakly and repeatedly failed spatial/typewell transfer.
payload.next_test: E011: compare orthogonal coefficient regression, three-control-point regression, family-specific coefficient experts, and conservative disagreement fallback under the frozen repeated/spatial/typewell/slice gates. Stop branches on a registered screen before full scoring.
